ablation_interpretation: Cost/structural-information ablation. Encoded age and task-index columns are invariant throughout a one-task episode. No age or stale-memory conclusion is possible. Masking also hides the affordable door identity.

generator.seed_hash: SHA256 canonical JSON list, first 16 digest bytes interpreted big-endian
generator.scenario_identity: Full study/split namespace, run seed or evaluation, family, scale, miss level and index; reserved masters are immutable protocol constants.
generator.episode_mixture: Cycle all 12 strata at episode creation; independent keyed layout/world draws. This does not promise equal decision counts.

features.mask: Same published explicit columns for actor and critic; remaining budget and regime probabilities stay visible.

gates.heldout: All ten final checkpoints plus frozen validation evidence; exclusive one-time generation receipt; incomplete generation is not silently retried.
